correctness.rationale: The three displayed commutator equations are necessary and sufficient for Y in T3 to centralize X. Distinct eigenvalues give q^3 distinct conjugated diagonal subalgebras for q>=3 (unitriangular stabilizer trivial). Two equal eigenvalues give three choices of repeated pair, each with split/nonsplit normal form, q^2 orbit centralizers per form; scalar-diagonal nilpotent cases give 1+1+2q+(q-1). Codimension and diagonal-image projections separate the strata. Result: c0=c1=1,c2=3q^2+2q,c3=3q^2+q-1+1_{q>2}q^3; q2=31 and for q>2 total q^3+6q^2+3q+1. Independently recomputed the commutator rowspaces from explicit matrix equations over F2,F3,F5, obtaining 31,91,291 and codim spectra (1,1,16,13),(1,1,33,56),(1,1,85,204). The submitted standard-library checker additionally covers F4,F7; this independent finite work corroborates universal orbit reasoning.
